name: Ocean
overview: Scripture reveals that the ocean, as part of God's creation, is under His sovereign control and authority. From the beginning, God created the sea and established its boundaries, demonstrating His power over the waters and their raging waves. Humanity, made in God's image, is given dominion over the fish of the sea, reflecting a divinely appointed stewardship. The ocean and its creatures testify to God's wisdom and creative order, inviting believers to recognize His majesty and rule over all creation.
